confidence_notes: I used four web searches: one for the RBA rate and three for Gdansk prices. The food and drink prices come from cost-of-living sites and guides, mainly Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, Freenance and Expatistan, and the sources varied. I converted prices using about 3.6 to 3.8 PLN per USD, my assumed rate. Beer at about 14 PLN, cappuccino at 14 to 17 PLN, an inexpensive meal at about 10.30 EUR or 35 to 50 PLN, and a mid-range meal for two at about 51.49 EUR or about 202 PLN were fairly consistent across sources. I raised them slightly because July is peak season and Old Town prices are higher. I found no reliable typical prices for cocktails or a glass of wine, only one bottle-price figure. I estimated those two from the beer price, at about 2.5x beer for a cocktail and about 1.7x for wine, so they are less certain. All four accommodation prices come from my general knowledge, not searches. They assume Gdansk's busy summer season on the Baltic, so the dorm, private room and 3-star hotel prices are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gdansk is a popular mid-sized tourist city in Poland. Its restaurant prices are about 10 to 15% above the national average and similar to Krakow and Wroclaw, slightly below Warsaw. For accommodation I compared it with Krakow's July peak-season prices.
